## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from publisher-disclosed practices (Elsevier ScienceDirect author guide) gathered 2026-05. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High — international ISSID (International Society for the Study of Individual Differences) authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium — non-Western personality data published within mainstream framework |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — gender, race, cultural personality differences regularly published |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Personality + individual differences — personality traits (3,131 articles), evolutionary psychology (1,479), personality disorders (1,254), cognitive abilities (1,102), psychological well-being (1,086) per OpenAlex |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must engage **structure of personality, individual differences, processes, or applications**. Scope welcomes experimental, correlational, theoretical, and expository/review work.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Manuscripts outside individual-differences scope redirected; high publication frequency (16 issues/year) means submission queue is fast-moving.

| Autoethnography | 1 | Rare |

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers drawn primarily from the ISSID (International Society for the Study of Individual Differences) network and broader personality-psychology community. Minimum 2 reviewers per submitted manuscript. Decision by editors (not by reviewers) — editorial gate is structural. Common reviewer demands focused on methodological rigor in psychometric and individual-differences traditions.

| **Reviewer competence variance** | Medium |
| **Quantitative mindset bias on qualitative work?** | Yes (strong) |
| **Discourse community signals (editorial board)** | International ISSID-affiliated programs |

### AI-Research Notes (supplementary AI research, 2026-07-13)

> Added as a **supplementary, independent research pass** — it does NOT overwrite or supersede the Tier assessment above. Treat conflicts as a signal to re-verify, not as an automatic correction. Overall `signal_quality` for this pass: **3/5**.

**AI-research finding (policy):** 遵循 Elsevier 出版社通用 AI 政策(非期刊專屬):作者可在寫作前使用生成式 AI/AI 輔助工具,但僅限改善語言與可讀性,必須在稿件單獨章節揭露使用情形;AI 不得列為作者,不得用於生成科學內容或取代研究判斷。屬「有條件允許+強制揭露」,故 leniency=3、gate=conditional。

**AI-research finding (positioning — what the journal accepts now):** 個性(personality)與各類個體差異(individual differences)之結構、成因歷程與實務應用研究。接受 experimental、correlational、theoretical、expository/review 四類文章。特別歡迎探討個體差異之遺傳、生物與環境基礎及其交互作用的稿件;並持續擴展至教育、社會/組織心理、臨床/健康心理等應用場域。2024-2026 近期實證主題集中於 Dark Triad(黑暗三合)與情緒智力(emotional intelligence)之關聯。

**AI-research finding (experiential):** 無版面費(不收 APC);年投稿量逾 2500 篇(中文論壇轉述);即使拒稿亦常給建設性意見與轉投建議。fabiaoji 11 筆中 3 接受/4 退稿/2 審查中。 審稿速度快、意見公允且具建設性(SciRev 報告品質 3.4/5、意見難度 3.3/5、整體處理 3.4/5;中文論壇多評『審稿速度快、意見中肯』)。通常 2-3 位審稿人、1-2 輪修改。無政治傾向相關具體來源,不作評述。

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside personality / individual differences scope
- Pure qualitative work
- AI-generated images per Elsevier policy
- Failure to disclose AI use

### Soft Tax

Low for psychometric / personality-tradition authors. High publication frequency (16 issues/year per community evidence: Elsevier 2026-05) means faster turnaround possible. 24-month AAM embargo on subscription path.

### Best Suited For

- Personality structure and individual-differences empirical studies
- Big Five, HEXACO, Dark Triad personality research
- Personality disorder dimensional research
- Cognitive abilities and intelligence research
- Evolutionary psychology empirical work
- Psychometric methodology contributions
- Cross-cultural individual-differences comparative studies
- Theoretical reviews of personality / individual-differences literatures

### Not Recommended For

- Pure autoethnography or first-person work
- Manuscripts outside individual-differences scope (consider JPSP, J Applied Psych)
- Critical / discursive personality work (consider Theory & Psychology)
- Authors needing rapid OA visibility (24-month AAM embargo)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Personality](./journal-of-personality.md) | Wiley peer; specialized in personality research; comparable individual-differences scope |
| 2 | [Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin](./personality-and-social-psychology-bulletin.md) | If the work has social-psychology angle; SPSP affiliated |
| 3 | [Journal of Personality and Social Psychology](./journal-of-personality-and-social-psychology.md) | Higher-tier APA flagship if work can be developed into multi-study program |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top personality-only venue, PAID is often a better fit because: it specializes in individual differences with broad methodological tolerance; ISSID affiliation provides built-in audience; high publication frequency accommodates faster turnaround; experimental, correlational, theoretical, and review formats all welcomed.
